towns.name: Wai Jhou
towns.summary: Wai Jhou (62.0S 51.4W) is a Sho town on the ridge of the Obsidian Plains near Small Black Hill, deep in the Direlands; its balconied buildings were a classic perch for young archers and mages in early Asheron's Call, and today it is known for the Shadow Hunters and Town Founder quest NPCs and its Colossus Foundry statue portal to Fort Tethana. The town lies at z 0 in a valley of black obsidian: a river runs south down a gorge between a scree slope and two 200 m obsidian spires and opens into a lake where a three-storey octagonal Sho pagoda (top z 31, purple, green and blue glows on its crown) stands in the water, joined to the shore by a stone pier lined with six flame lanterns; on the shore a two-storey Sho hall with standing lanterns beside a 40 m blue-leaved tree, the Nullified Statue of a Shadow on its plinth, the Town Network portal, and to the south a low shrine with blue-flame torches and a spire-roofed house among dense trees.
